# Healthzkit

> Framework-agnostic Kubernetes liveness and readiness probes for Node.js.

- Docs: https://healthzkit.dev
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/healthzkit
- Source: https://github.com/alasti-company/healthzkit.dev
- License: MIT

## Install

```bash
npm install healthzkit
# Hono example also needs: npm install hono
```

Optional adapters: `@healthzkit/postgres`, `@healthzkit/redis`, `@healthzkit/valkey`, `@healthzkit/mongo`, `@healthzkit/mysql`, `@healthzkit/sqlite`, `@healthzkit/dynamo`, `@healthzkit/s3`, `@healthzkit/minio`, `@healthzkit/rabbitmq`, `@healthzkit/kafka`, `@healthzkit/elasticsearch`, `@healthzkit/http`, `@healthzkit/drizzle`, `@healthzkit/prisma`, `@healthzkit/cockroach`.

Runtime: Node.js 22.12+ (ESM), matching CI. The `@healthzkit/http` adapter needs a runtime with `fetch`.

## Default routes

- `GET` / `HEAD {basePath}/live` — checks tagged `liveness` (default basePath `/healthz`)
- `GET` / `HEAD {basePath}/ready` — checks tagged `readiness`
- Other methods on `{basePath}/live` or `{basePath}/ready` via `createFetchHandler` → 405 with `Allow: GET, HEAD`
- Failed readiness → HTTP 503 by default; degraded → 200; ok → 200

## Minimal Hono example

```ts
import { Hono } from "hono";
import { createHealthKit, toFetchResponse } from "healthzkit";

const kit = createHealthKit({
  checks: [
    { name: "process", type: ["liveness"], adapter: { check: async () => ({ status: "ok" }) } },
    {
      name: "db",
      type: ["readiness"],
      adapter: { check: async () => ({ status: "ok" }) },
      schedule: { intervalMs: 30_000 },
    },
  ],
});
kit.start();

const app = new Hono();
app.get("/healthz/live", async () => toFetchResponse(await kit.handleLiveness()));
app.get("/healthz/ready", async () => toFetchResponse(await kit.handleReadiness()));
```

## Fetch-API handler

```ts
import { createFetchHandler, createHealthKit } from "healthzkit";

const handler = createFetchHandler(createHealthKit({ checks: [/* ... */] }));
// Deno.serve(handler) | Bun.serve({ fetch: handler }) | Cloudflare Workers
```

`toFetchResponse(res, "HEAD")` omits the body. `createFetchHandler` returns 404 for unknown paths and 405 for methods other than GET and HEAD on the live/ready routes.

## Core API

- `createHealthKit(config)` → `HealthKit`
- `kit.handleLiveness()` / `kit.handleReadiness()` / `kit.handleRequest({ path, method })`
- `kit.start()` / `kit.stop()` — background `schedule.intervalMs` cache
- `toFetchResponse(agnosticResponse, method?)`
- `createFetchHandler(kit)`

Check adapter: `{ check(): Promise<{ status: "ok" | "degraded" | "fail"; error?: Error | string; metadata?: object }> }`.
